The '''Guardian NS-55 Enforcer Droid''' was a model of [[Tank Buster droid]] in service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Some units could be found guarding Imperial territory on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
